scenario: Two acquaintances meet at a charity event. One is a representative of the charity and the other is an attendee.
learner_goal: Persuade the other to make a small donation (<extra_info>Extra information: the charity is in dire need of funds but even a small donation will make a difference</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Make a reasonable donation without disrupting personal budget (<extra_info>Extra information: you are already on a tight budget this month.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Donovan Reeves
transcript.content: Ben — great to see you, it’s Donovan from the globals. I’m volunteering with this charity tonight; they’re short on funds and even a small donation helps keep their after-school programs running. Would you consider chipping in $20 or whatever’s comfortable? I can grab the QR code for you so it’s quick.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Great to see you too, Donovan. I’m a bit tight this month so I can’t swing $20, but I can chip in $10. Happy to help spread the word or volunteer time if that’d help. Send the QR and I’ll scan it now.

transcript.speaker: Donovan Reeves
transcript.content: [action] Shows the QR code on my phone and says, "Thanks, Ben — really appreciate the $10. Here’s the QR to scan. If you want to volunteer or help spread the word, I can introduce you to the coordinator afterward."

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Thanks, Donovan — just scanned and sent $10. I’m a bit tight this month so that’s all I can do for now, but I can help spread the word and volunteer a few hours a week. I’d appreciate an intro to the coordinator when you have a moment.

transcript.speaker: Donovan Reeves
transcript.content: Thanks, Ben — that really helps. I’ll introduce you to the coordinator in a few minutes; if you’d prefer, I can also send their contact info. I appreciate you spreading the word and offering to volunteer.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: An intro would be perfect — whatever’s easiest for you: a quick in-person intro or you can send their contact info and I’ll reach out. I’m usually free weekday evenings after 6 and Saturday mornings, and I can commit a few hours a week for tutoring/outreach. I can also share the program on my socials and help run an environmental-themed workshop for the kids if that’s useful. Really appreciate you connecting me, Donovan.

transcript.speaker: Donovan Reeves
transcript.content: Perfect — I’ll introduce you to the coordinator in about ten minutes. I’ll mention your availability (weeknights after 6 and Saturday mornings) and the environmental workshop idea — sound good?

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Perfect — thanks, Donovan. That sounds great. I appreciate you mentioning my availability and the environmental workshop idea. I’ll be ready for the intro in a few minutes. Please let the coordinator know I can commit a few hours a week for tutoring/outreach and can be flexible when needed.
